<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Offers (quantity, price, delivery time)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartBatch" name="Part batch delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint mail"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract" name="Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Buyer" name="Buyer (contract project)" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query parts" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderOne" name="Order" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSeveral" name="Order" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartBatch" name="Part batch" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PartBatch" messageRef="Message_PartBatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint" sourceRef="SendTask_ComplainMail" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PartsNeeded" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query web shops for parts"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Offers" name="Receive offers (quantity, price, delivery time)" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare offers and create parts list per shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EnoughFromOne_Split" name="Enough parts from one shop?" default="Flow_SeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderOneShop" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops" name="Order cheapest parts from several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Order_Merge" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Wait_Merge" name="Wait for part batch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_PartBatch" name="Part batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PartBatch" messageRef="Message_PartBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToStock" name="Add arrived parts to stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FirstBatch_Split" name="First batch?" default="Flow_NotFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock_Merge" name="Stock checked"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck_Split" name="Stock level of part?" default="Flow_StockOk"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts from fastest shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ComplainMail" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complaint" name="Complaint sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QueryToOffers" sourceRef="StartEvent_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersReceived" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompareOffers" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Offers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnoughCheck" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enough parts from one shop</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderOneMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSeveralMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToWait" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PartBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BatchToStock" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_PartBatch" targetRef="Task_AddToStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockToFirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_AddToStock" targetRef="Gateway_FirstBatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstBatch_Split" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">first batch received</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotFirstBatch" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstBatch_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuildingToMerge" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToStockCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ComplainMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock == 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" name="Below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock > 0 and stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" name="Below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck_Split" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock >= 3 and stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockOk" name="5 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderFastestMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderCheapestMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplainToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_ComplainMail" targetRef="EndEvent_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
